name: detect_opt_out_intent
description: Detect if a seller message contains opt-out or opt-in intent for RFQ notifications

intent.description: The detected intent: opt_out (wants to stop notifications), opt_in (wants to receive notifications), or none (no opt-out/in intent)

confidence.description: Confidence score as percentage (0-100) for the classification

reasoning.description: Brief explanation of why this intent was detected

detected_phrases.description: Key phrases from the message that indicate the intent
